dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000pijd](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000pijd) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Jan 08 2025 87km W of Madoi. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 34.7767 longitude 97.4386. It impacted 599 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
